      Squad data

      Paste one player per line as year,team,player,games,career, one row per season. games is games for that club that season; career is the player's career total and is optional. Games are added up per player per club across the four eras (1998–2000, 2001–2009, 2010–2019, 2020–2026). A header row is fine.

      Points and eligibility are based on games — how many games that player played for that club, in that era — not career. A career column is optional and currently just along for the ride. Anyone over 100 games for that club/era stays in the squad, but Lock it in will tell you they're too well known rather than pretend they don't exist.

        How to play

        Classic

        Pick a year, tap Team to draw a random club, then name players who turned out for that club in that era. Only players with 100 games or fewer for that club, in that era count — someone who barely played there still counts even if they were a star elsewhere.

        Points depend on how obscure the player is:

        • 1 game — 100 pts
        • 2–5 games — 50 pts
        • 6–10 games — 20 pts
        • 11–20 games — 10 pts
        • 21–50 games — 5 pts
        • 51–100 games — 1 pt

        No timer, but only 10 wrong guesses across the whole game (15 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass) — rack up too many and it's game over. Three hints per round. First to 500 points wins.

        ⭐ Immortals: name one of the official Rugby League Immortals at any point in a Classic game and bank a flat 300 pt bonus, shown in gold — we won't tell you who they are, that's part of the challenge. Works once per Immortal per game, so there's a maximum of 4,200 bonus points on top of the regular 500 if you know your history. Classic only.

        Blitz

        Pick a year and tap Start. Name as many players as you can from any club in that era with under 20 games in that era (added up across clubs if they played for more than one), before the 60 or 90 second timer runs out. Same points as above apply. Once it starts, the timer can't be restarted — only ended by time running out or Give up. Come away with nothing and it's game over — tap Try again for a fresh go. No name suggestions, and hints need a 🎟️ Ruck Pass here.

        League Legend

        No year to pick — tap Team for a random club and name anyone who's ever played for them, 1998 to 2026. You've got 10 minutes per club, and every player counts — even the club's biggest legends, worth whatever their points tier gives (which may be next to nothing for a true great). The catch: only 8 wrong guesses across the whole 10 minutes (12 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass) before it's game over early, so you need to actually know a club back to front, not just rattle off names and hope. Draw a new club any time to reset the clock, or Give up early to see who you missed and log your score. No name suggestions, and hints need a 🎟️ Ruck Pass here.

        Daily Challenge

        Same club for everyone, once a day — tap the 🔥 Today's Challenge banner up top to jump straight in. 5 minutes, same scoring as League Legend (no name suggestions while you type, so you've got to know them, and hints need a 🎟️ Ruck Pass same as there), and the leaderboard only ever compares you to others who played today's club, since some clubs give you a lot more to work with than others. Blank the whole 5 minutes and it's game over.

        👑 Rugby League God

        One random club, no timer — but only 5 turns (8 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass). Every guess costs a turn, right or wrong, and you need 300 points before they run out. Same scoring as League Legend, so it pays to go for the obscure ones rather than the easy, well-known names. Hit 300 and you're a Rugby League God; run out of turns short and it's game over — tap Try again for a fresh club. No name suggestions here either — you're on your own.

        🏆 RLWC Mode

        No year to pick — tap Nation to draw one of the 9 Rugby League World Cup nations (Australia, New Zealand, Tonga, Samoa, Cook Islands, PNG, Lebanon, France or Fiji) at random. Name anyone with 20 caps or fewer for that nation since 1998 — same obscurity scoring as Classic (the fewer caps, the more it's worth), and a correct guess spins you straight into a new nation. No eras here — it's caps for country, not games for club. Found players are shown in that nation's colours. First to 200 points wins — but only 5 wrong guesses across the whole game (8 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass), or it's game over.

        ⚔️ State of Origin

        No random draw — pick NSW or QLD yourself. Name anyone who's played for that state since 1998, as many games as they like. A player with just 1 Origin game for that state is worth 50 points; everyone else is a flat 10. Switch states any time, your points carry over — first to 300 wins, but only 10 wrong guesses across the whole game (15 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass), or it's game over.

        🧠 RUCK TRIVIA

        No squad to search — just one clue, built from a real combination of a player's club games, international caps and Maroons Origin games, e.g. "I played 142 games for the Dolphins and 8 caps for Australia. Who am I?" Type the one player it describes. Get it right and you're straight onto the next clue; get it wrong and it costs a strike. Only 6 wrong guesses across the whole game (10 with a 🎟️ Ruck Pass) before it's over. No name suggestions — a single-player roster would just hand you the answer — and a 30-second shot clock per clue, same as Classic and Daily. First to 250 points wins.
